description: Democrat Kelly Kirschner leads Republican Sydney Gruters 40% to 39% in a new survey of Florida’s 16th Congressional District. The live interviewer/text to web poll was conducted by SEA Research & Political Design from August 25 to 29 and surveyed 400 respondents across the newly drawn 16th Congressional District which spans from St. Petersburg to Arcadia.
title: Poll: Kirschner & Gruters in Dead Heat in FL-16 - Kelly Kirschner for U.S. Congress - FL 16
